scenes.line1: How does Angular connect data and UI?
scenes.say: Ever wonder how Angular links your data to the interface—and why interviewers always ask about it?

scenes.label: Component
scenes.sub: UI building block with class, template, and style
scenes.say: First up, components. They're the building blocks of every Angular app, each defined by a class, a template, and optional styles.

rows.b: Keeps data and UI in sync

scenes.say: Data binding comes in three flavors: property binding sends data from your logic to the view, event binding handles user actions, and two-way binding keeps everything in sync.
Here's a real example. We pass a user into a component with property binding, and listen for a save event with event binding.

scenes.question: Does event binding send data to the view?
scenes.right: No, event binding sends data from the view to your logic—property binding updates the view.
scenes.say: Quick check: does event binding send data to the view? Actually, it works the other way—event binding sends data from the view to your logic.
